title.zh: 赌场管制（指定第一场地）命令 2012
title.vi: Lệnh Kiểm soát sòng bạc (Địa điểm thứ nhất được chỉ định) 2012
title.th: คำสั่งการควบคุมคาสิโน (สถานที่แห่งแรกที่กำหนด) 2012
title.id: Perintah Pengendalian Kasino (Lokasi Pertama yang Ditetapkan) 2012
title.ms: Perintah Kawalan Kasino (Tapak Pertama yang Ditetapkan) 2012

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Casino Control (Designated First Site) Order 2012 and shall be deemed to have come into operation on 23rd August 2006.

2. All those parcels of land at Marina Bay, as shown delineated and marked on the Land Parcel Plan in the Schedule, comprised in Town Subdivision 30 in —
(a)Lot numbers 342V, 348X, 349L, 382X, 528C and 529M;
[S 321/2016 wef 08/07/2016]
(b)the airspace in Lot numbers 70008M, 70010C, 70011M, 70013V, 70014P, 70015T, 70016A, 70017K, 70030V, 70031P, 70032T and 70033A; and
[S 321/2016 wef 08/07/2016]
(c)the subterranean space in Lot numbers 80022X, 80023L, 80024C, 80025M, 80026W, 80027V, 80051K, 80052N and 80053X,
[S 321/2016 wef 08/07/2016]
shall be designated the Marina Bayfront site on which a casino may be located for a period of 30 years commencing on 23rd August 2006.
3. The Casino Control (Designated First Site) Order 2006 (G.N. No. S 501/2006) is revoked.
